blurb: Guests rent jet skis and boats to explore lakes and canals, including guided tours and custom excursions. The fleet includes Yamaha VX Cruiser HO jet skis with Bluetooth audio and a 27ft Flagship Tritoon boat with a Suzuki 350 hp engine. Safety equipment and training are provided, and rentals include fuel.
